Name: Dark Skull Cavern
Author: coldazrael
Description:
[b]Version 1.1 Changes :[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed graphical bug during Mr. Qi's quest
[*]Added new model for Serpent, the Apophis Serpent!
[/list]
Are you feeling bored with yellow-flashy Skull Cavern? Embrace the darkness! Download this mod and step through the entrance of the famed Skull Cavern! Twisted monsters awaits you there...

Carbon Ghosts are Blood Spectres,
Mummies, Iridium Bats, and Iridium Crabs are imbued with darkness,
Serpents are now Shadow Serpents, once you've heard their hissing you could no longer easily spot them by their previous greeny scales, as they are now moving freely, nearly camouflaged in the darkness of the cavern.

[b]Installation :[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install Content Patcher if you haven't installed it yet.
[*]Download the Mod,
[*]Drop the Mod folder to Mods folder.
[/list]
[b]Config Options :[/b]
Unless you don't want to change some of the mod defaults then ignore this. Start by opening the config.json file with text editor (I personally prefer Notepad++).[list]
[*][i]EnableMod[/i] 
Master config to turn on and turn off the mod, the values are "true" or "false". The default is "true".[*][i]TilesetRetexture[/i]
Config that changes the Skull Cavern environment, the values are "enabled" or "disabled". The default is "enabled", set to "disabled" if you wanted to keep the vanilla Skull Cavern environment.[*][i]SerpentToggle[/i]
Config for serpent replacement, the values can be toggled between "Normal", "Glow", "RedCrest", "Apophis", "ApophisGlow" and "disabled". The default is "Normal", set to "disabled" if you wanted to keep the vanilla Serpent.[*][i]MummyToggle[/i]
Config for mummy replacement, the values can be toggled between "Corrupted", "RedEyes", and "disabled". The default is "Corrupted", set to "disabled" if you wanted to keep the vanilla Mummy.[*][i]IridiumBatToggle[/i]
Config for iridium bat replacement, the values can be toggled between "Corrupted", "RedEyes", "RedEyeswFangs" and "disabled". The default is "RedEyes", set to "disabled" if you wanted to keep the vanilla Iridium Bat.[*][i]CarbonGhostToggle[/i]
Config for Carbon Ghost replacement, the values are "enabled" or "disabled". The default is "enabled", set to "disabled" if you wanted to keep the vanilla Carbon Ghost.[*][i]IridiumCrabToggle[/i]
Config for Iridium Crab replacement, the values are "enabled" or "disabled". The default is "enabled", set to "disabled" if you wanted to keep the vanilla Iridium Crab.[/list]

Downloads.Description: Drop the folder to Stardew Valley/Mods/
